exposure: Hammersmith Neonatal Neurologic Examination (HNNE) performed early (HNNE PE, before discharge)
Hammersmith Neonatal Neurologic Examination (HNNE) performed at recommended age (HNNE RA, 40 weeks postmenstrual age for preterm, 2 weeks postnatal age for term)
cohort: The study enrolled preterm and at-risk term neonates.
finding: Hammersmith Neonatal Neurologic Examination (HNNE) performed early (before discharge) demonstrated similar predictive ability for neurodevelopmental disability at 1 year of age compared to HNNE performed at the recommended age.
